title: dep-scan error document
description: The document a dep-scan verb in json format writes on stdout when it exits 1, 2 or 4: a command that could not run, a usage error, or a requested capability that cannot run here. The same message always goes to stderr as text, so a caller reading stdout learns the failure in one document and a human watching stderr sees one line. Exit code 0 never produces this document, and a scan whose individual targets fail keeps its own output document with the failures inside.

exitCode.description: The exit code the process ends with: 1 when the verb could not run, 2 for a usage error, 4 for a requested capability that cannot run here.

verb.description: The verb that failed, or the empty string when the command line named no verb, as on a usage error argparse finds before any verb runs.

message.description: One human-readable line saying what failed. The same text is printed on stderr.

details.description: Optional, verb-specific structured facts about the failure. The scan verb names the unknown checks it was given as {"unknownChecks": [...]} on a usage error, and the capability that cannot run as {"capability": <name or null>, "reason": ...} on exit 4. The doctor verb names the unknown capabilities as {"unknownCapabilities": [...]} on a usage error and the unmet requirements as {"unmet": [...]} on exit 4. The serve verb carries the capability reason on exit 4. The vdb and schema verbs add no details beyond the message.
